name: ui
note: source/app is the app's own production build (npm run build in toyz-mood-fm); it is not committed. The same screens are live at https://mood-fm.toyz.kr. The app seeds six weeks of sample diary entries relative to the day it runs; the archive is captured on September 2026, a month full of them. The on-air stage, the tuner, the mood pad and the logo are drawn in the reel from the app's own code (domain/mood.ts, domain/color.ts, domain/music.ts, app.css, Icons.tsx), not captured.
